review_conflicts.details: Gamuda Norton Park marketing source uses Thuan Giao/former Binh Duong whereas republished issuer-hosted prose says Dong Nai; event in HCMC must not be mistaken for project location. Location and GIS point both blocked.
About 4,000 project apartments vs 375 apartments specifically in Green Sapphire; tower and phase counts should not be summed as independent entire projects.
Green Topaz Q1/2025 stated as anticipated handover in 2023; September 2025 progress for other towers cannot prove complete handover.
Orchard Hill 774 apartments and Orchard Heights 436 apartments are different phases; The Orchard 368 landed houses must be excluded. Master Sycamore mixed units != apartment total.
Issuer's 95% Zenia sales success must not be loaded as independent transaction or legal eligibility.
An Gia issuer pages failed direct reads (502/internal error); reserve indexed snippets for manual source checking, no price observation.
Jan 2026 structural topping out is not apartment handover.
Hung Thinh office address in building is not a legal parcel, first handover, or independent building GPS validation.
